cards.text: It's the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the day the Passover lamb is sacrificed. Jesus' disciples ask Him where He wants them to prepare for Him to eat the Passover. Big holiday meal and no location yet, friend, which is every family group chat in history.
So Jesus sends two of them into the city and tells them how they'll find the place.

cards.question: Jesus sends two disciples into the city to find the place for the Passover. Who does He say will meet them there?

answers.text: A man carrying a jug of water
A man leading a young donkey
A woman drawing water at a well

cards.text: Follow him, Jesus says, and tell the owner of whatever house he walks into: "The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?"

cards.question: Jesus says the owner of the house will show the two disciples a room for the Passover. What kind of room?
True or false: When the two disciples get to the city, things don't go the way Jesus described.

cards.text: They find the upper room furnished and ready, and they prepare the Passover.
When evening comes, Jesus arrives with the Twelve. They're reclining and eating when Jesus says, "Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me…"

cards.question: In the middle of the Passover meal, Jesus says one of the people eating with Him will do something. What?
True or false: After Jesus says one of them will betray Him, the disciples start asking Him one by one if He means them.

cards.text: They're grieved, and one after another they ask Him, "Surely not I?" It's like the boss saying somebody in this office messed up, and suddenly the whole team is replaying every email they sent this week.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the one who will betray Him is someone from outside the Twelve.

cards.text: It's one of the Twelve, Jesus says, the one dipping his hand into the bowl with Him. Same bowl, friend, that close.

cards.question: Jesus, calling Himself the Son of Man, says He will go just as it is written about Him. What does He say about the man who betrays Him?

answers.text: Better for him if he'd never been born
He'll be driven out of the land forever
His name will be wiped from every record

cards.text: While they're eating, Jesus takes bread, speaks a blessing, breaks it and gives it to the disciples, saying, "Take it; this is My body." Then He takes the cup, gives thanks and gives it to them, and they all drink from it.

cards.question: Jesus just called the bread His body. What does He call the cup the disciples all drank from?

cards.text: Jesus tells them, "This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many." Then He talks about the next time He'll drink of the fruit of the vine.

cards.question: Jesus says He won't drink of the fruit of the vine again until the day He drinks it anew. Where does He say that will be?

cards.text: They sing a hymn and head out to the Mount of Olives. Sparkle, one of my cookie cutter kids, used to hum to the oven while it warmed up, and the first time I tried it here, my oven turned itself OFF.

cards.question: Out at the Mount of Olives, Jesus tells the disciples what all of them are going to do. What does He say?

answers.text: They will all preach in Jerusalem

cards.text: Jesus points to what is written: "I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered." Hard news, but He's not done talking.

cards.question: Right after quoting "I will strike the Shepherd…" Jesus tells the disciples that after He has ___, He will go ahead of them into Galilee.

cards.text: Peter, one of the Twelve, isn't having it: "Even if all fall away, I never will." That's me at night setting a 5 a.m. alarm, FULLY convinced tomorrow's me is a morning person.

cards.question: Peter just promised he'll never fall away. Jesus says that this very night, before the rooster crows twice, Peter will do something. What?
True or false: After Jesus says Peter will deny Him three times, Peter backs down from his promise.

cards.text: Peter keeps insisting, "Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You."

cards.question: True or false: When Peter insists he'll never deny Jesus, the rest of the disciples say the same thing.

cards.text: We're pulling this batch out of the oven right here, friend. Keep that apron on, because this story is far from done.
